notes.title: Lust Academy Season 4 – Release Date Revealed!
notes.notes:
[h3]Big News, Mages! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859716/9737fb5ecc2fd1548b46dd8e2a1de4990aac7df9.png[/img]

It’s time to mark your calendars because [b]Lust Academy Season 4[/b] officially launches on [b]May 8[/b]! We've been working hard to make this the biggest and most exciting season yet, and we can’t wait for you to experience it.

[h3]Why You Should Wishlist Now:[/h3]
Wishlisting isn’t just a small button click—it’s a huge help for us as developers! The more wishlists we have, the better our chances of reaching more players and making Lust Academy even better. If you’re excited about Season 4, please add it to your wishlist today and ask your friends to do the same!

[h3]Still Haven’t Played the Demo?[/h3]
You still have a chance to play [b]the Season 4 Demo[/b], but time is running out! The demo will disappear before launch, so now’s the perfect moment to dive in and get a taste of what’s coming.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3230990/Lust_Academy__Season_4/ style=button][b]Wishlist Now[/b][/url] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3350450/Lust_Academy_Season_4_Demo/ style=button][b]Play Demo[/b][/url]

Thank you for your support—your wishlists mean the world to us!

notes.title: Update on Our Sales Campaign!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859716/97d80154037fc31013ef0da6004135ef24b37edc.png[/img]
We are ready to update our sales campaign results. 

Yes, we understood the goals we set were ambitious. And prizes were also overly attractive. We really were incredibly close to reaching the first milestone. It’s cool!

Your support through purchases, reviews, and everything else has been incredible. Because of this overwhelming support, we are happy to announce that we have still decided to implement the first item on our list. Additionally, we feel your passion and want to find a way to make you even happier.

Let's discuss what else you'd like to see from us from the provided list [url=https://discord.gg/6BjYgftP][b]on our Discord[/b][/url].

Your love, voices, and opinions are inspirations for us. Maybe we will transform it into new challenges for our team.

Thank you for your amazing support!❤️❤️❤️

notes.title: Official Release: Dive into the Sensual World of Lust Academy Season 3!
notes.notes:
Calling all true magic enthusiasts and adventure seekers! We're thrilled to announce the release of [b]Lust Academy Season 3[/b], an adventure that promises a full-body, uncompromising journey into the realm of passion and mystery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859716/c2f5eb8f29a6cb73cea0082bf79d3f7dc8c5549d.png[/img]
[b]"Lust Academy - 3"[/b] is not just a sequel; it's a whole new chapter in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/LustAcademy][b]Lust Academy saga[/b][/url], packed with fresh storylines and beloved characters. Get ready for more feels, more believability, and of course, more passion than ever before!

Embark on an unforgettable adventure and experience the magic for yourself. 

Grab your copy now and immerse yourself in the tantalizing world of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2655960/Lust_Academy__Season_3/]Lust Academy Season 3[/url][/b]. 🌟

notes.title: Lust Academy Season 3 Release Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859716/cf1a31773c7b725be1bafca50ac7f939eaca5a7e.png[/img]
We are happy to announce that our beloved game's highly anticipated [b]Season 3[/b] is just around the corner — it will launch [b]in the next month[/b]!

The journey to this moment has been a labor of love. We've been working super hard on this, listening closely to your feedback every step of the way. 

As we get closer to the big day, we'd love your continued support. Tell your friends and fellow gamers about the game, and make sure [b]to add it to[/b] [b]your Steam wishlist[/b].

Your enthusiasm fuels our passion, and we can't wait to share this new page of our adventure with you.

Keep an eye on [url=https://discord.com/channels/756246065451106336/1031605756966998026][b]our Discord[/b][/url] for more updates and sneak peeks as launch day approaches. 

[b]Get ready for a fantastic adventure in Season 3![/b]

[i]Sincerely, 
Bear in the Night team.[/i]
